description:
Replace an unretryable blocked task without losing its lineage.

    Creates a fresh, explicitly planned task under the same roadmap item and
    attempt lineage, transfers prerequisites and downstream dependents, and
    cancels the stale task with supersession provenance. The old PR, task,
    failures, criteria, and evidence remain in the audit history; nothing is
    marked delivered. Inputs over 200 title characters, 20,000 body characters,
    10 criteria or 2,000 decision characters are rejected without writes;
    accepted specifications are never shortened.

    ``workspace_strategy`` is required whenever structured records identify
    undelivered implementation: ``fresh_main`` starts the replacement clean,
    while ``carry_forward`` reuses the declared ``recovery_source_pr_number``
    after an authenticated GitHub read verifies an available, unmerged PR. The
    head SHA is always resolved by the server. ``carry_forward`` stays refused
    until the deployment enables the runner path.
name: replan_task
title: Replan Task
